After the CFPB dropped lawsuits, complaints against those firms rose by an average of over 75%.

summaries.summary: Lauren Boebert, a Colorado Republican, acknowledges Trump's actions may have hurt her constituents, despite losing her House seat.
points: Boebert lost her US House seat during the midterm elections.
She suggests the election results could reflect a referendum on Trump.
Boebert states she is not mad at the president despite the loss.

summaries.summary: Alessandro Masullo proposes a proof of the GRH, reviewed by Brian Conrad, to be released urgently.
summaries.significance: The proposed proof of the GRH by Alessandro Masullo, vetted by Brian Conrad, could significantly advance algebraic geometry if validated.
points: Brian Conrad has been reviewing Masullo's proof for months.
The proof is human-generated, with no AI involvement.
The draft is being released early, bypassing initial plans for further refinement at Stanford.

summaries.summary: Researchers have generated proofs for the finite time blowup in unforced Euler and Navier-Stokes equations, and a potential proof for the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis, all with significant AI assistance.
points: Levent Alpöge, Tristan Buckmaster, and Matei Coiculescu provided a human-readable proof for the finite time blowup in unforced incompressible Euler equations in three dimensions.
Alpöge and Buckmaster produced a proof for the finite time blowup in unforced incompressible Navier-Stokes equations in three dimensions, with a Lean formalization.
Levent Alpöge generated a Lean-only proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis using an internal AI model, currently under verification.

summaries.summary: Mathematician Alessandro Masullo's proposed proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis is nearing public release after months of review.
summaries.significance: A proposed proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis by Alessandro Masullo, vetted by Brian Conrad, is set to be released, potentially impacting mathematics significantly.
points: Brian Conrad has provided extensive feedback on the proof over months.
Initial plan was to refine the proof at Stanford before a wider announcement.
Current draft will be released sooner than originally planned.

summaries.summary: Joanne Young, who was drugged and raped by her husband and his associates, spoke out after her abusers were convicted.
summaries.significance: The conviction of Young’s abusers signals progress in justice system reforms, offering hope to future victims.
points: Young waived her anonymity to speak outside Winchester crown court.
Her abusers invited other men to assault her over years.
Years of reforms by prosecutors and police contributed to the convictions.

summaries.summary: UK cybersecurity operation prevented a cyber-attack on supermarket fridges and freezers, similar to attacks that hit at least seven European countries.
points: Attack targeted supermarkets, warehouses, restaurants, petrol stations, and stadiums in the UK.
Similar attacks in Europe caused damage worth many millions of euros.
While many UK retailers are now protected, researchers warn that many more could still be vulnerable.

summaries.summary: Police search for a missing teacher convicted of sexual relationships with pupils in the 1980s who skipped her sentencing.
points: Sally-Anne Bowen, 65, convicted of indecent assaults at a boys’ school in the late 1980s.
Warrant issued for her arrest after she failed to appear at Harrow crown court.
Metropolitan police could not locate her at her Hemel Hempstead home.
